content:
Maya (Sales): Heads-up 1 ACME just asked for the pen-test + vuln scan artifacts and a remediation timeline. They want anything shareable by EOD tomorrow.
Devin (Security): We have the full report from BlueOak red-team (2026-03-14). Raw reports are internal-only. I can produce a sanitized bundle for external consumption.
Maya (Sales): Key asks from ACME: findings list, remediation ETA per finding, proofs of fix (screenshots/logs), and confirmation that shared PoCs are non-exploitable. Also they want sha256 of bundle for integrity.
Ishaan (Eng): Quick status on top items: FIND-12 (unauth file access) 1 fix in review (PR#5480), canary deploy in 5 days. FIND-03 (token replay) 1 mitigation available via token expiry config + patch PR planned.
Devin (Security): Sanitation rules I'll apply: remove exploit payloads, redact IPs and internal hostnames, strip full stack traces that include secrets, include reproduction steps as pseudo-steps (no code).
Maya (Sales): Legal reminded: do not include any working exploit chains. We need a signed note from security to paste in the vendor package.
Devin (Security): I can sign a note: "I attest that artifacts in the 'shareable' bundle are sanitized to remove active exploit code and do not include working payloads or credentials."
Maya (Sales): Perfect. Also ACME asked whether we can commit to remediation SLAs in the SOW. They propose: Critical=10bd, High=30bd.
Ishaan (Eng): Realistically Critical=10bd requires a hotfix team, cherry-pick, and prioritized CI. We can do single critical in 10bd if we branch and freeze scope. Multiple criticals will need more time or cost.
Devin (Security): Suggest internal SLAs: Critical=14bd default, but we can offer 10bd as an upsell/hotfix addendum. High=30bd, Medium=60bd, Low=90bd.
Maya (Sales): I'll offer ACME: Critical 10bd (with hotfix SOW) / High 30bd / Medium 60bd / Low 90bd. Include one complimentary retest within 10bd of patch.
LegalBot: automated-note: Ensure export controls; if ACME is outside approved region, obtain approvals before sharing.
vendor-risk-bot: external-scan: Nessus scan completed 2026-03-16; report stored at internal/raw/nessus-20260316.json
Maya (Sales): Can you prepare the shareable bundle and the sha256 so I can send it to ACME? They want to validate after download.
Devin (Security): Working on bundle now. Contents to include: summary-onepager.pdf, findings.csv (id,severity,short_desc,owner,eta), sanitized-logs/, screenshots/, remediation-guides/, signoff.txt.
Ishaan (Eng): I'm attaching PR and test links for the top items: PR#5480 (FIND-12 fix) https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/5480; test run link: CI job #7212.
Maya (Sales): Please add short remediation ETA estimates in findings.csv. ACME expects specific dates not relative days.
Devin (Security): ETA estimates added: FIND-12: 2026-03-30; FIND-03: 2026-04-04; FIND-09 (info leak): 2026-04-20.
Maya (Sales): Great. Also include a README with audit trail and contact for escalation.
Devin (Security): Will do. Signoff line to include: "I confirm artifacts in `shareable/` are sanitized and do not contain runnable exploit code or operational credentials." 1 Devin (Security).
Maya (Sales): Uploaded sanitized bundle to internal staging S3: s3://redwood-evidence/staging/acme-2026-03-18/shareable/
Maya (Sales): sha256: b2c4f5d7e9a12b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1e2f3a4b5c6d7e8f90123456789abcdef12
Devin (Security): Noted. Also recording audit-id: VR-20260318-21.
Ishaan (Eng): I'll coordinate canary metrics so ACME can get proof-of-fix (logs and metric snapshots) after deploy.
Maya (Sales): Sending email to ACME now with summary.pdf, findings.csv, signoff.txt, and sha256. I'll CC legal and security.
Maya (Sales): Email sent. Waiting for ACME reply.
ACME (external): thanks, received. Can we get the raw PoC for an internal risk team review? (sent via ACME security contact)
Devin (Security): Reply to ACME: raw PoCs are internal-only. We can provide controlled review under an NDA + explicit approval process; propose a joint call and provide sanitized walk-throughs.
Maya (Sales): ACME accepted NDA route; wants timeline for raw PoC disclosure (after NDA executed). They also asked to confirm the 10bd hotfix is acceptable.
Devin (Security): NDA timeline depends on legal; I estimate 3-5 business days.
Maya (Sales): Noted. Closing action items:
- Devin: finalize shareable bundle + signoff (done)
- Ishaan: keep PRs moving and prepare proof-of-fix artifacts (in progress)
- Legal: expedite NDA (requested)
Maya (Sales): Will update thread when NDA is signed or ACME requests more evidence.
vendor-risk-bot: note: package shared (shareable/) and audit log generated.
Maya (Sales): Thanks everyone. Keeping thread open until NDA/retests complete.
